editorial:
Imagine spending a wild weekend in the Latvian countryside with a group of friends and family who can't seem to get along. You get a great mix of awkward romantic tension and family drama as everyone gathers for St. John's Night. The vibe is very relaxed and sunny, making you feel like you are right there at the bonfire with them. You will follow a few different couples who are all searching for the legendary magic fern, hoping it will bring them luck in love. It feels like a cozy summer party where everything that could go wrong eventually does, but in a funny and relatable way.

What really works here is how the movie captures that feeling of a family reunion where secrets slowly come out. The acting feels natural and the pacing keeps you interested without feeling rushed. While it is a smaller movie and doesn't have huge plot twists, the sweet moments make it worth your time. It is a perfect pick for a rainy Sunday afternoon when you need a smile.
endingExplained: By the end of the night, the characters realize that the magic fern is not actually a real plant they can find in the woods. Instead, the search serves as a way for them to be honest about their feelings. The couples finally stop playing games and admit they love each other. The movie wraps up with a feeling of peace and new beginnings as the sun rises over the celebration.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves romantic comedies and stories about family bonds.
